description_en: Creates a topic for ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ. A topic is the top-level container for message transmission and storage in ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ, used to identify messages of the same business logic. In the messaging model, producers send messages to a topic, and consumers consume messages by subscribing to a specified topic
description_zh: 创建云消息队列 RocketMQ 版的主题（Topic）。主题是云消息队列 RocketMQ 版中消息传输和存储的顶层容器，用于标识同一类业务逻辑的消息。在消息收发模型中，生产者将消息发送至主题，消费者通过订阅指定的主题来消费其中的消息
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq create-topic --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --topic-name topic_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTopic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the topic to be created belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待创建主题所属的实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the topic to be created. The name is used to identify the topic and must be globally unique.

Naming conventions:

Character limit: letters a-z or A-Z, digits 0-9, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Length limit: 1 to 60 characters.

For reserved character restrictions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html
parameters.help_zh:
待创建主题的名称，用于标识主题，全局唯一。

取值规范如下：

字符限制：支持字母a\~z或A\~Z、数字0~9以及下划线（_）、短划线（-）。
长度限制：1~60个字符。

保留字符限制，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html
parameters.name: topic_name

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the lite topic, in minutes.
Valid values: 30 to 720.
Default value: -1, which indicates the topic never expires
parameters.help_zh:
lite类型的Topic过期时间，单位：分钟
取值范围：30-720。
默认-1，表示永久存在
parameters.name: lite_topic_expiration

parameters.help_en: The maximum TPS for sending messages
parameters.name: max_send_tps

parameters.help_en:
The message type of the topic to be created.

<notice>The type of the topic must be consistent with the type of messages sent to it. For example, if you create a topic of the ordered message type, the topic can be used only to send and receive ordered messages, not other types of messages.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待创建主题的消息类型。

<notice>主题的类型和发送消息的类型必须一致。例如，您创建的主题的类型为顺序消息，则该主题只能用于收发顺序消息，不能收发其他类型的消息。></notice>
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.example: This is the remark for test.
parameters.help_en: The remarks for the topic to be created
parameters.help_zh: 待创建主题的备注信息
parameters.name: remark

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique ID, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful
